svg.text: A confusion matrix in one call
What the library draws, with its own defaults
scikit-learn draws it straight from the model.
Each row as shares of that genre, so rows compare fairly.
A row is a real genre; a cell, the share of its songs given
that guess. The diagonal is each genre’s recall.
